title: Crispy Vietnamese Pancake
description: A crispy and flavorful Vietnamese pancake, perfect as a side dish or snack.

ingredients.name: Crispy Pancake Batter
ingredients.notes: Available in most Asian grocery stores.

ingredients.name: Scented Lemongrass
ingredients.notes: Use the leaves and tender shoots for added flavor.

ingredients.name: Bean Sprouts
ingredients.notes: Fresh or canned, for added texture.

instructions: Heat 1/2 cup of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Pour the crispy pancake batter into the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the edges start to curl.
Flip the pancake and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until crispy and golden brown.
Add the scented lemongrass, green onions, and bean sprouts on top of the pancake.
Fold the pancake in half to enclose the filling.
